scope: Playwright WebKit and Firefox desktop/narrow viewport. WebKit touch emulation where supported. No actual Safari, physical device or human usability assurance.
cases: Import all 28 strings, save, and compare parsed notes exactly, including imported CRLF/CR/Unicode/empty/space-only values.
Edit owner, then save; preserve all other 27 source strings byte-for-byte as JS strings.
Reject native confirmation; current saved notes remain exactly unchanged.
Malformed JSON rejected before replacing any existing notes.
Duplicate escaped note key rejected atomically.
Reopening same file twice triggers two independently handled selections.
All blank text/date and initial native choices remain valid and save exactly.
Native select/date values persist on change; full selected wording appears separately.
Reopen status, preview and text export retain no-verification and no-approval caveats despite positive self-reported choices.
No requests beyond local static assets on entry/edit/import/export; local/session storage and IndexedDB remain empty.
At desktop 1440px and narrow 390px and 320px widths, document has no horizontal overflow and controls stay within viewport.
Reload loses unsaved notes and restores defaults.
Dispatch empty file selection after a loaded draft; all 28 strings remain unchanged.
